warnings.summary: No Docker, IaC, or CI/CD deployment configuration detected.
warnings.detail: The documented Vercel + Render path is manual and has no reproducible deployment pipeline in the repository.
warnings.fix: Add deployment configuration and CI checks for client and server.

warnings.summary: Local JDBC fallback disables MySQL TLS.
warnings.detail: application.properties uses useSSL=false in the fallback URL; production must provide a TLS-enabled DB_URL.
warnings.fix: Make DB_URL mandatory in production and require useSSL=true with the provider CA/TLS settings.

warnings.detail: spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update is unsafe for controlled production migrations.
warnings.fix: Use validate or none in production and run versioned migrations explicitly.

warnings.summary: JWT has a weak fallback secret.
warnings.detail: The application has a development secret fallback if JWT_SECRET is absent.
warnings.fix: Fail startup when JWT_SECRET is missing or too short in production.

warnings.summary: CORS is configured in two layers.
warnings.detail: SecurityConfig and AppConfig both register CORS behavior, increasing drift risk.
warnings.fix: Keep one authoritative CORS configuration and test exact production origins.

warnings.summary: No frontend health endpoint is defined.
warnings.detail: Static hosting can serve /, but deployment probes and smoke checks are not formalized.
warnings.fix: Use the static root check and add deployment smoke tests.

warnings.summary: Legacy PHP implementation has no deployment manifest.
warnings.detail: It is explicitly out of scope in the root README and should not be deployed with the React/Spring system.
warnings.fix: Exclude php_project from production builds or document a separate PHP deployment.

warnings.summary: Development localhost defaults remain in runtime configuration.
warnings.detail: They are acceptable for local development but must be overridden and verified in deployment environments.
warnings.fix: Set VITE_API_URL and FRONTEND_URL to exact HTTPS production origins.
